title: 旋出螺钉
task: Unscrew the screw from the fixture using an allen key while sitting at a table with a pink tablecloth and lavender background.

AV-A.caption: Pick up the allen key from the table
Unscrew the screw from the fixture using the allen key
Unscrew the screw from the fixture with the allen key
Place the screw on the table
Insert the allen key into the screw on the fixture
Place the removed screw on the table
Remove the black bracket from the base plate

AV-B.caption: pick up allen key with right hand
unscrew screw from fixture with allen key in right hand
hold allen key with right hand, pick up screw with right hand
hold allen key with right hand, place screw on table with right hand
loosen screw on fixture with allen key in right hand
hold allen key with right hand, pick up screw and place screw on table with right hand
place allen key on table with right hand, reposition fixture on table with right hand

AV-C.caption: pick up allen key with right hand
unscrew screw from fixture with allen key in right hand
hold allen key with right hand, pick up screw and place screw on table with right hand
loosen screw on fixture with allen key in right hand
unscrew screw from fixture with allen key in right hand
unscrew screw from fixture with allen key in right hand
hold allen key with right hand, pick up screw with right hand
place screw on table with right hand, place allen key on table with right hand
pick up fixture and place fixture on table with right hand
